subject: Sam
_note: A DEMO profile. It carries the taste MODEL (axis weights, scoring notes, named loves) so the engine behaves exactly as documented, but the person is fictional. Replace it with your own: the weights are the part you are meant to change.

mission.secondary: watch for-sale stock to build value-spotting judgement
mission.area: A drawn city polygon rather than a named postcode list

current_home.verdict: characterful and loved, upgrading on size/baths/outdoor

scoring_notes.light_and_volume: ceiling height, window count/size, aspects, skylights, vaulted/double-height; penalise dark lower floors and single-aspect mews
scoring_notes.outdoor_space: garden > roof terrace > balconies; inside-outside flow (glazed doors from kitchen/living) is a bonus; great terrace can carry a listing
scoring_notes.character_bones: two accepted flavours: (a) Victorian period: brick, bay windows, natural floorboards, fireplaces, cornicing; (b) exceptional one-off: warehouse/pub/architect/boat. Enemy = bland/generic
scoring_notes.width_proportion_flow: double-fronted = strong bonus; skinny/narrow = kill; layout must flow
scoring_notes.street_scene: score the street via maps: trees, neighbouring stock quality, garden squares, market streets; bad street kills | UNTESTED in round 1 (location-blind human); validate round 2
scoring_notes.raw_size_threshold: fail <900 sqft; fine 900-1100 if wide; comfortable 1100-1600; diminishing above
scoring_notes.design_finish: rentals: finish is real but modulates within ~1 point; carpets/marble/cabinets get named yet 9s still land when character+light are exceptional
scoring_notes.floor_position_rule: lower/raised-ground ideal WITH direct garden access; top floor fine with terrace/light

anti_signals: modern kitchen in a period house (mild)
cheap/careless spec (flip laminate, grey landlord refurb) - kill
open-plan-only living (no separate living room) - dock

hard_constraints.outdoor_space: required (private strongly preferred; shared-only = -3 penalty not fail)
hard_constraints.note: real size gate is usable width/layout, not raw sqft

rules.price_within_band: gate + tiebreak only, never a scoring input
rules.outdoor_rule: softens under high character; never for bland buildings
rules.mews: judge per property; double height flips darkness prior
rules.rating_input: voice/language native; engine converts to numbers
rules.condition_axis_split: kill CHEAP/CARELESS (flip spec, laminate, bad photos); AGED/ECLECTIC/WARM with bones is neutral-to-positive
rules.separate_living_room: open-plan-only = dock; wants a distinct living room or a second reception
rules.furnishing: fixable - score bones, suggest unfurnished; dock only when it signals cheapness
rules.staging_flag: carry a staging-inflation flag on beautifully photographed listings
rules.dual_output: predicted reaction + viewing flags (floorplan catches) as separate outputs

round2.anchoring_check: passed - scores moved against leaked commentary both directions
round2.street_axis: still untested - he skips maps on unexciting pools (motivation-gated)
